Dawn Patrol

Brooklyn, NY · Prospect Park · Road

Dawn Patrol is a road group ride in Brooklyn, NY. It rolls every Thursday at 7:00 am from Grand Army Plaza.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: a and B groups, double paceline. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @dawnpatrol.pp the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Dawn Patrol group ride

A Thursday morning training ride in Prospect Park for women: cis women, trans women, and non-binary people who would race in a women's field. Started by riders from the Continental Ostroy team. Five or six laps in a paceline, then coffee. You should be comfortable riding close to others in a busy park.
